title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with Iuka Bancshares, Inc. and The Iuka State Bank
raw_text:
July 30, 2026
Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with Iuka Bancshares, Inc. and The Iuka State Bank
For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced the execution of the following enforcement action listed below:
Iuka Bancshares, Inc., Salem, Illinois and The Iuka State Bank, Salem, Illinois
Written Agreement dated July 15, 2026
Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here.
